card.name: HIV terms and blood pressure openers
card.fires_on: The first piece of a term whose next piece is fixed: " HIV" before -1, the "n" starting nelfinavir, and "blood" before pressure. It also fires on "-N" in treatment-naïve.

modes.label: HIV before -1
modes.description: The word HIV right after "in" in PrEP dosing text, before the -1.
modes.example: Recommended dosage in<< HIV>>-1 uninfected adults and adolescents

modes.label: Start of nelfinavir
modes.description: The letter n that begins the drug name nelfinavir in interaction text.
modes.example: In patients taking the HIV protease inhibitor<< n>>elfinavir or the hepatitis C

modes.label: Blood before pressure
modes.description: The word blood in phrases about restoring or maintaining blood pressure.
modes.example: Quinapril and hydrochlorothiazide treatment usually can be continued following restoration of<< blood>> pressure and volume.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look unrelated and mixed.
